question: Which among the following Universities is founded by Pandit Madan Mohan Malaviya?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Banaras Hindu University.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ​In **Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh, India,** there is a research, central, and collegiate university called **Banaras Hindu University.**
 
• In** 1916**, it was founded.
 
• The **Central Hindu College **was established in** 1898 by Annie Besant, **an Indian Home Rule Leaguer and Theosophist.
 
• Following the **exclusion of Besant** and her colleagues, **Madan Mohan Malaviya **founded the institution.
 
• He took the** financial assistance** of the kings of** Dharbhanga Rameshwar Singh, Benares Prabhu Narayan Singh, and Sunder Lal.**
 
• The university is one of the **eight public institutions** that the Indian government has designated as **Institutes of Eminence.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Delhi University:**

 
 
• It is a **central collegiate university.**
 
• An **Act of the Central Legislative Assembly **established it in **1922.**
 
 
 
• **Punjab University:**
 
 
• In **Chandigarh, Punjab**, there is a public state institution called Panjab University.
 
• It has its roots in the **1882** establishment of the **University of Punjab** in Lahore.
 
 
 
• **Sambalpur University :**
 
 
• It is situated in **Burla town**, in the district of **Sambalpur, in Odisha.**
